utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, 10am works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that repair drive is actually going to work? I've seen these things fail before.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Oren knows his stuff. I'm not worried.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope they've planned for enough parking spaces and a schedule that doesn't overlap with rush hour.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'll mention that to Vik and Ira when I see them. They're good at planning details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief. I'd hate for the whole thing to turn into a traffic jam.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, thanks Opal, that's really helpful! I'll add the Johnson shingles and Miller spigot to our repair list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, let's make sure we incorporate those when we plan the schedule tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Mara. Let's meet at my place at 10 AM to hash out the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, what's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, you know, just fixing up some old stuff people have lying around. I think I was supposed to bring something... maybe my toaster?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, the repair drive is for the server, not your toaster. Did you mix them up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, heard anything new about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes! I'm planning to set up a schedule this weekend, and Jules is going to help spread the word on Maple Street and at the community center group.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, sounds like things are coming together. Let me know if you need me to mention it to anyone else I run into.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure about that drive, Tess. I've been a bit distracted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you should come! They're fixing bikes, toasters, and even that old lawnmower of yours. It'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate the offer, Tess, but I'm not in a good place for fun right now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Eli, have you heard anything about this repair drive everyone's been talking about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I heard it's this Saturday at the community center. They've got a schedule posted on the bulletin board.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks Eli! I'll swing by the community center to check that board.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, just send me the list and I'll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, I'll text you the list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll keep an eye out for your text tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me which repair drive we're talking about? The server one or the laptop one?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry Hana, I just got here—what repair drive are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's the server repair drive, Dane. Mina mentioned it might be broken.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Opal, I'm trying to keep track of supplies for the repair drive. Do you know what's still needed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've noted the Johnson house needs new shingles and the Miller place could use a new spigot. Have we got those on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I think I have those noted from Sarah's list. We might need a few more hands to pick them up though.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Noah, I was thinking we could use the school calendar to plan the repair drive. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: School calendar? That sounds like a good idea. I think they have one in the community center, but I'm not sure where it is.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Mara mentioned she can get a copy of the school calendar. Let's meet with her tomorrow to plan the times.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam! I'm helping organize a repair drive in the neighborhood—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Quinn! I'd love to help out. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Sam! Do you have any broken items you want to fix, or are you more into helping others with repairs?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Tess, I've been meaning to ask if you've heard about the supplies we're collecting for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yes! I heard we're collecting all sorts of things. I even mentioned it to Kira earlier, though she seemed a bit skeptical. But I think it's a wonderful idea!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's great to hear! Do you know if you'll be able to contribute any tools or materials?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Opal, have you heard any updates on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven't heard official updates, but I did notice some loose shingles on the Johnson house and a leaky spigot at the old Miller place. Could be good starting points.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good eye, Opal. I'll swing by and mention those spots to Jules—every little bit helps get this drive rolling.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, what's the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure, Mina. I've only heard whispers about it myself. Maybe we can figure it out together?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm worried the server repair drive might be broken. Have you heard anything about that?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Gus, what do you think about the repair drive? I hope they've sorted out the parking and scheduling.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I hope so too. I'm still ready to bring my tools and help out any evening they need me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's great, Gus. I'm sure they'll appreciate the extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, a repair drive? Sounds like a great idea! Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I'm not sure we have enough folks yet, but I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let me talk to some of the other neighbors; I bet I can round up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Eli, are you free tomorrow to meet with Mara and me about the repair drive timing?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm always free in the mornings. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: How about 10am at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Sam, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I hope I got the time right—around 10?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, this Saturday at 10 sounds great! I'll be there with my tools. Thanks for checking in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I'll bring my trusty screwdriver set. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you specify which repair drive you mean, Pia?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Honestly, I'm not sure of the details—I just hope they've planned for parking and times so it doesn't turn into chaos.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I get your worry about the planning, but I still need to know which repair drive you mean—the server one or the one for the old laptop?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm late as usual—but I'm definitely in for the repair drive! What's the plan?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rosa's got a checklist, just follow her lead.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I'll check in with Rosa for the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Jules, I'm not sure about the details either. Maybe Sarah knows?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I've been helping spread the word too. Maybe we can all chat with Sarah together?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That sounds like a good idea, let's go find Sarah.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: How does tomorrow at 10 AM work for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Tomorrow at 10 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Leo! Let's meet at my place then, I'll have the school calendar ready.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, what exactly is this repair drive supposed to do? I'm not convinced it'll work.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's a community effort to fix up homes that need small repairs, Kira. We're starting with Maple Street, and I'm confident it'll bring us closer together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But who's organizing this, and how do we know it's not just going to cause more problems?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
